summary.request: Sales orders get a delivery route. Warehouse staff must be able to pull only the released sales orders for one route into a warehouse shipment through the source document filters. Items also get a brand code that must default onto sales lines, including when the salesperson picks a substitute or a catalog item, and a substitute line must remember the brand that was originally ordered.
summary.business-process: Adds a delivery route to sales orders that warehouse shipments filter on through Warehouse Request and Get Source Documents, and a brand code that defaults from the item onto sales lines through standard item, catalog item and substitution routes; changes sales order entry, release, warehouse shipment creation and sales posting.

open-questions.question: Should Delivery Route and Brand Code be validated against new lookup tables (a route list and a brand list)? If yes, those tables need their own design (table type, pages, permission set, classification), and the field lengths must match the related key.
Where does the delivery route come from on a new sales order: typed by the user only, or defaulted from the customer or ship-to address?
May the route change on a released order? The design requires reopen and release; the alternative is to update the Warehouse Request directly when the route changes.

Besides the source document filter, should the route also filter the single-document path (Get Source Doc. Outbound / Source Documents list, OnGetSingleOutboundDocOnAfterSetFilters) and inventory picks (Create Invt Put-away/Pick/Mvmt), and should the route be carried on purchase return orders or transfers through their own release codeunits?
Should Delivery Route or Brand Code also appear on warehouse shipment lines, picks and posted warehouse shipments? That is a separate copy step not designed here.

The design mirrors Delivery Route on all posted sales headers and Sales Header Archive, and Brand Code / Requested Brand on all posted sales lines and Sales Line Archive. Are any of these document types (credit memos, return receipts, archives) not needed?
Should the route or the brand reach customer ledger entries, item ledger entries or G/L entries? Not designed.

When a document is copied, should Delivery Route flow back from posted or archived headers, and should Requested Brand survive Copy Document when lines are recalculated (it is dropped on that path; Brand Code is re-defaulted from the item)?
Should new items get a brand from the item template (add Brand Code to Item Templ. with the same number, name, type and length)?
Should Requested Brand be filled only on substituted lines, or on every line (equal to Brand Code when no substitution happened)? And should it be cleared if the user later changes No. manually?
Existing items, open orders and posted history will have blank route and brand. Is upgrade or install code needed to fill them?
Do quotes, blanket orders, return orders or purchase documents need the route or brand defaults, or only sales orders?
